scope: Authenticated discussion creation derives actual User from current complete Session, current raw board/group/type-policy snapshots and locks, before/after credential+authority recheck and required audit/outbox atomic commit. An uncreated resource is never represented as an editable thread.

environment.database: owned disposable PostgreSQL16 loopback tmpfs; real Community Thread/Governance/Identity User+Session/Reliability repositories and native transaction credential lock tests

coverage.creator_audit_rollback: actual Thread/revision/outbox/platform audit rollback when required audit fails
coverage.credential_locks: actual User and Session rows remain locked within write transaction; second connection FOR UPDATE NOWAIT yields 55P03
coverage.http: actual User/Admin domain JWT and SessionService Memory Identity; current owner edit, other/admin/missing proof/forged authority DTO/revoked credentials rejected
coverage.audit: Memory and PG actual content state/revisions/outbox/platform command audit rollback on required audit failure

boundaries: This slice does not complete V12-02b. Typed Feature author writes, governance/Admin/MFA actor audit, Admin lists, batch and effective permission preview remain.
Raw service helpers remain trusted internal primitives; HTTP author update uses the checked entry and requires actual transaction/audit adapters.
No new migration. This only delivers User author updates; Admin is never an author substitute.
HTTP components use Memory Identity; PG resource+credential+atomic audit commands are separately accepted. No full production server, Windows or browser acceptance claimed.
